flags.issue: All <Update> label attributes are translated into French (e.g., label="Juin 2026", label="Mai 2026", label="Avril 2026", etc.). The source uses English month names (label="June 2026", label="May 2026", etc.). These labels generate anchor IDs (e.g., #june-2026 vs #juin-2026), so translating them breaks any inbound links or same-page anchor references that target the English-derived IDs. Component prop values that drive anchor generation must not be translated.
flags.suggested_action: Revert all <Update label="..."> values to their English source strings (e.g., label="June 2026", label="May 2026", label="April 2026", label="March 2026", label="February 2026", label="January 2026"). Displayed human-readable text from labels can be separately overridden if needed, but the attribute value itself must remain unchanged.

flags.issue: Two <Step> titles translate "Commit and push" as "Valider et pousser". In French, "valider" means "validate" or "submit a form", not "commit" in the git sense. Using "valider" for a git commit is a false friend that misguides readers into thinking the step is about validation rather than a git commit operation.
flags.suggested_action: Change the Step titles from "Valider et pousser" to "Committer et pousser" (or keep "Commit et pousser" using the English technical term), which is the standard French developer convention for git commit.

flags.issue: Inside the <Note> block, the source text reads "Any /path link in your docs content is treated as an internal docs link." The translation renders this as "Tout lien /chemin dans le contenu de votre documentation...", replacing the literal placeholder /path with the French word /chemin. The /path here is a code-style placeholder (not prose to be translated) and changing it to /chemin invents a path string that does not appear in the source.
flags.suggested_action: Restore the literal code token: replace "/chemin" with "/path" so the sentence reads "Tout lien /path dans le contenu de votre documentation est traité comme un lien interne vers la documentation."
